run-map skill: evaluating generated bot waypoints against the author's - analyze_waypoints.py and how to log its input from a temporary hook.

The editor's arena settings have a Bot waypoints section: the mode, Density and a Preview seed, a note on what the mode does with this map ("Your 23 waypoints will be used."), and Generate into layer random_waypoints / Same seed - one undoable step overwriting that layer with waypoints generated like a round would (spawns and bombsites from the project, a navmesh made just for it if the scene has none). The random_waypoints layer is only a preview: never one of the author's waypoints and never used in game.

Bot waypoints can be generated every round (random_waypoints_generator, isolated from the cosmos): path distances over the navmesh - all nav islands as one grid, joined by their portals (augs::lower_grid_distances, Dial's algorithm with a cutoff) - from each team's spawns and the bombsites place pushes a little past the middle towards the enemy and patrols between the spawns, most around the bombsites, every bombsite with at least two. Weighted Poisson disk sampling spreads them along the main routes, never closer than the spacing by path to each other or to the author's waypoints; rays rate each patrol spot (rate_patrol_spot): a covered spot with an open view gets a long camp, an open one a short look around, a long view may make the bot look far. A map's bot_waypoints (common significant): AUTOMATIC uses the author's waypoints if there are any and generates otherwise, YOURS_AND_GENERATED adds generated ones around the author's, RANDOM_EVERY_ROUND leaves the author's out of the game; density scales the count. Generated right after the clean round state from get_round_rng_seed, so every client makes the same ones. 200 seeds on de_silo, de_cyberaqua, fy_minilab, de_duel_practice and de_facing_worlds: about as many patrols as the authors placed, 81-88% of the authors' patrol spots get one within 600 px in a round, coverage as good or better; 0.2-1.3 ms per round (de_cyberaqua the longest) in RelWithDebInfo. Unit tests: determinism, spacing, the author's complemented, every bombsite patrolled, across portals.
